site.name: Aurora CloudBank Symbolic
site.subtitle: GitHub Pages Launchpad
site.description: Repo-backed static portal for evaluating, building, operating, and researching Aurora without pretending GitHub Pages is the runtime.

personas.label: Evaluate
personas.summary: Start with repo evidence, architecture, documented routes, and static demos before committing to a local runtime or deeper deployment work.
outcomes: Understand what GitHub Pages actually serves.
Inspect system posture from tracked deployment evidence.
Compare the static portal to documented API and architecture surfaces.

personas.label: Build
personas.summary: Use the documented local setup path, contributor docs, and SDK/frontend references to get a real development environment running.
outcomes: Bootstrap a local environment with the supported commands.
Find the docs that matter before touching runtime code.
Move from Pages orientation into real build surfaces quickly.

personas.label: Operate
personas.summary: Treat Pages as a static launch surface, then pivot into monitoring, health checks, incident docs, and deployment references for actual runtime work.
outcomes: Read the deployment posture and runtime boundaries clearly.
Jump into monitoring and incident-response docs without hunting.
Probe health and metrics from a local or deployed runtime.

personas.label: Research
personas.summary: Map Aurora's conceptual, ethics, and quantum-symbolic materials without losing the concrete API and code entrypoints behind them.
outcomes: Link conceptual docs to code and API surfaces.
Navigate research and ethics references from one static index.
Start deeper investigation from concrete files, not slogans.

opsChecklist: Confirm the tracked deployment status is READY before presenting Pages as current system posture.
Use make setup, make check, and make run for local runtime work instead of treating Pages as the application runtime.
Probe /health and /metrics from a live service instance, not from GitHub Pages.
Use monitoring, incident-response, and security docs before exposing a runtime outside local development.
Treat Pages as an evidence, docs, and demo surface that points users into the real repo and runtime.
